title: Life sciences and pharma ontology
description: Portable life-sciences and pharmaceutical semantics imported from the supplied Lattice ontology.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Ontology
metadata:
  name: life-sciences
  title: Life Sciences and Pharma Ontology
  description: Fundamental entities and relationships shared across Life Sciences and Pharmaceutical decision contracts.
  version: 0.1.0
  source:
    system: lattice
    sourceId: life-sciences-ontology
    sourceVersion: 0.1.0
    sourceDigest: sha256:6cd2c0dbee1641e515a7165ec8063b6d636f1a1c1290153a6ddc18edcdc342f0
spec:
  types:
    - id: drug_product
      label: Drug Product
      description: A governed drug product (SKU) including molecule, dosage, and form.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0
      properties:
        - id: drug_product.drug_product_id
          label: Drug Product Id
          description: Stable drug product identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/0
        - id: drug_product.trade_name
          label: Trade Name
          description: Brand or trade name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/1
        - id: drug_product.generic_name
          label: Generic Name
          description: INN or generic name of the active substance.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/2
        - id: drug_product.dosage_form
          label: Dosage Form
          description: Tablet, capsule, injection, inhaler, etc.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/3
        - id: drug_product.strength
          label: Strength
          description: Strength such as 10mg, 5mg/ml.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/4
        - id: drug_product.ndc
          label: NDC
          description: National Drug Code.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/5
    - id: clinical_trial
      label: Clinical Trial
      description: A governed clinical trial study.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1
      properties:
        - id: clinical_trial.trial_id
          label: Trial Id
          description: Stable trial identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/0
        - id: clinical_trial.protocol_number
          label: Protocol Number
          description: Protocol or study code.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/1
        - id: clinical_trial.phase
          label: Phase
          description: Trial phase such as Phase 1, 2, 3, 4.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/2
        - id: clinical_trial.indication
          label: Indication
          description: Indication or therapeutic area.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/3
        - id: clinical_trial.status
          label: Status
          description: Planned, recruiting, active, completed, terminated.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/4
        - id: clinical_trial.start_date
          label: Start Date
          description: Trial start date.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/5
        - id: clinical_trial.primary_completion_date
          label: Primary Completion Date
          description: Primary completion date.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/6
    - id: trial_subject
      label: Trial Subject
      description: A de-identified subject enrolled in a clinical trial.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2
      properties:
        - id: trial_subject.subject_id
          label: Subject Id
          description: De-identified subject identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/0
        - id: trial_subject.enrollment_date
          label: Enrollment Date
          description: Date of enrollment.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/1
        - id: trial_subject.arm
          label: Arm
          description: Treatment arm such as placebo, low dose, high dose.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/2
        - id: trial_subject.status
          label: Status
          description: Enrolled, active, withdrawn, completed, screen failure.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/3
        - id: trial_subject.site_id
          label: Site Id
          description: Clinical site identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/4
    - id: adverse_event
      label: Adverse Event
      description: A governed adverse event or safety report.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3
      properties:
        - id: adverse_event.event_id
          label: Adverse Event Id
          description: Stable adverse event identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/0
        - id: adverse_event.onset_at
          label: Onset At
          description: Onset date and time.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/1
        - id: adverse_event.severity
          label: Severity
          description: Mild, moderate, severe, life-threatening, fatal.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/2
        - id: adverse_event.serious
          label: Serious
          description: Whether the event is a serious adverse event (SAE).
          dataType: boolean
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/3
        - id: adverse_event.meddra_term
          label: MedDRA Term
          description: MedDRA preferred term or LLT.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/4
        - id: adverse_event.causality
          label: Causality
          description: Investigator causality assessment.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/5
    - id: batch_record
      label: Batch Record
      description: A governed pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing batch.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4
      properties:
        - id: batch_record.batch_id
          label: Batch Id
          description: Stable batch identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/0
        - id: batch_record.batch_number
          label: Batch Number
          description: Manufacturing batch number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/1
        - id: batch_record.manufacturing_date
          label: Manufacturing Date
          description: Date the batch was manufactured.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/2
        - id: batch_record.batch_size
          label: Batch Size
          description: Planned batch size with unit.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/3
        - id: batch_record.status
          label: Status
          description: Released, on hold, rejected, quarantined.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/4
        - id: batch_record.expiry_date
          label: Expiry Date
          description: Expiration date of the batch.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/5
    - id: regulatory_submission
      label: Regulatory Submission
      description: A governed regulatory submission to a health authority.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5
      properties:
        - id: regulatory_submission.submission_id
          label: Submission Id
          description: Stable submission identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/0
        - id: regulatory_submission.agency
          label: Agency
          description: Health authority such as FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/1
        - id: regulatory_submission.submission_type
          label: Submission Type
          description: IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, CTA, etc.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/2
        - id: regulatory_submission.submitted_at
          label: Submitted At
          description: Date of submission.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/3
        - id: regulatory_submission.status
          label: Status
          description: Draft, submitted, under review, approved, rejected, withdrawn.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/4
        - id: regulatory_submission.decision_at
          label: Decision At
          description: Date of regulatory decision.
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/5
    # Shared core types
    - id: person
      label: Person
      description: A human being identified in a governed business context.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6
      properties:
        - id: person.person_id
          label: Person identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the person.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/0
        - id: person.display_name
          label: Display name
          description: Preferred name used in governed interfaces.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/1
        - id: person.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which this person record is valid.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/2
    - id: organization
      label: Organization
      description: A governed legal, public, or operating organization.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7
      properties:
        - id: organization.organization_id
          label: Organization identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the organization.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/0
        - id: organization.legal_name
          label: Legal name
          description: Registered or otherwise authoritative organization name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/1
        - id: organization.organization_type
          label: Organization type
          description: Governed classification of the organization.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/2
    - id: agent
      label: Agent
      description: A human or software actor authorized to perform governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8
      properties:
        - id: agent.agent_id
          label: Agent identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the actor.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/0
        - id: agent.agent_type
          label: Agent type
          description: Whether the actor is human, service, or automated.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/1
        - id: agent.active
          label: Active
          description: Whether the agent is currently authorized.
          dataType: boolean
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/2
    - id: location
      label: Location
      description: A physical, administrative, or virtual place relevant to governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9
      properties:
        - id: location.location_id
          label: Location identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the location.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/0
        - id: location.name
          label: Location name
          description: Human-readable location name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/1
        - id: location.country_code
          label: Country code
          description: ISO country code when applicable.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/2
    - id: document
      label: Document
      description: A governed information artifact with identity, version, and provenance.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10
      properties:
        - id: document.document_id
          label: Document identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the document.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/0
        - id: document.title
          label: Title
          description: Authoritative document title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/1
        - id: document.version
          label: Version
          description: Document version or revision.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/2
        - id: document.issued_at
          label: Issued at
          description: Time at which the document was issued.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/3
    - id: event
      label: Event
      description: A governed occurrence bounded by time and business meaning.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11
      properties:
        - id: event.event_id
          label: Event identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/0
        - id: event.event_type
          label: Event type
          description: Governed classification of the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/1
        - id: event.occurred_at
          label: Occurred at
          description: Time at which the event occurred.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/2
    - id: asset
      label: Asset
      description: A governed physical, digital, or financial resource.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12
      properties:
        - id: asset.asset_id
          label: Asset identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the asset.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/0
        - id: asset.name
          label: Asset name
          description: Human-readable asset name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/1
        - id: asset.asset_type
          label: Asset type
          description: Governed classification of the asset.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/2
    - id: policy
      label: Policy
      description: A versioned rule or standard governing decisions and actions.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13
      properties:
        - id: policy.policy_id
          label: Policy identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the policy.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/0
        - id: policy.title
          label: Policy title
          description: Authoritative policy title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/1
        - id: policy.version
          label: Version
          description: Approved policy version.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/2
        - id: policy.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which the policy applies.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/3
  relationships:
    - id: trial_investigates_drug
      label: INVESTIGATES_DRUG
      description: Clinical trial investigates a drug product.
      sourceTypeId: clinical_trial
      targetTypeId: drug_product
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/0
    - id: subject_enrolled_in_trial
      label: ENROLLED_IN
      description: Trial subject is enrolled in a clinical trial.
      sourceTypeId: trial_subject
      targetTypeId: clinical_trial
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/1
    - id: adverse_event_for_subject
      label: FOR_SUBJECT
      description: Adverse event associated with a trial subject.
      sourceTypeId: adverse_event
      targetTypeId: trial_subject
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/2
    - id: adverse_event_involves_drug
      label: INVOLVES_DRUG
      description: Adverse event involves a drug product.
      sourceTypeId: adverse_event
      targetTypeId: drug_product
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/3
    - id: batch_yields_drug_product
      label: YIELDS_DRUG_PRODUCT
      description: Batch record yields a drug product.
      sourceTypeId: batch_record
      targetTypeId: drug_product
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/4
    - id: submission_for_drug
      label: FOR_DRUG_PRODUCT
      description: Regulatory submission references a drug product.
      sourceTypeId: regulatory_submission
      targetTypeId: drug_product
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/5
    - id: submission_for_trial
      label: FOR_TRIAL
      description: Regulatory submission references a clinical trial.
      sourceTypeId: regulatory_submission
      targetTypeId: clinical_trial
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/6
    - id: member_of
      label: MEMBER_OF
      description: A person is affiliated with an organization.
      sourceTypeId: person
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/7
    - id: acts_for
      label: ACTS_FOR
      description: An agent acts on behalf of an organization.
      sourceTypeId: agent
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/8
    - id: located_at
      label: LOCATED_AT
      description: An organization operates at a location.
      sourceTypeId: organization
      targetTypeId: location
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/9
    - id: documents
      label: DOCUMENTS
      description: A document records or describes an event.
      sourceTypeId: document
      targetTypeId: event
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/10
    - id: involves_asset
      label: INVOLVES_ASSET
      description: An event involves a governed asset.
      sourceTypeId: event
      targetTypeId: asset
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/11
    - id: governed_by_policy
      label: GOVERNED_BY_POLICY
      description: An event is governed by an applicable policy.
      sourceTypeId: event
      targetTypeId: policy
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/12
    - id: owned_by_organization
      label: OWNED_BY_ORGANIZATION
      description: An asset is owned or stewarded by an organization.
      sourceTypeId: asset
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/13
